The register with the pair each stopped row executed

report_executed_register.Rd

A row that stopped after the channel executed it keeps on the instance the access executed, and the servers are asked about that one, not about the one the register holds now. Two ways of knowing it, as in the round:

Usage

report_executed_register(
  register,
  logs,
  creators,
  approvers = NULL,
  channel_account = NULL
)

Arguments

register

The register as read.

logs

One element per row, in the register's order: the row's log, or NULL where it was not read.

creators

Who created each row, as log_creators() answers.

approvers

The IT accounts whose approval counts on any row, or NULL when the caller does not know them.

channel_account

The REDCap usernames that hold the register's token, or NULL when they are not configured.

Value

The register, with server, project_id and username the ones executed, and four columns more: username_registro, the name the register holds; nome_eseguito, registro or log, where the name executed was read, "" when it is not known; nome_motivo, why not: log or approvatori, "" when it is known; revoca_eseguita, TRUE on a revoked row whose state executed, log_executed_values() on request_status, is revoked: carried out, then touched, so that report_scope() leaves it out of ferma. A log that does not say leaves it FALSE.

Details

  • the seal did not move: the register is what was executed. The seal is the channel's last one in the row's log, log_channel_seal(), when the channel's account is configured, as the round reads it; otherwise the field;

  • the seal moved: the values the round last carried out, read from the log by log_executed_values(), which needs the IT approvers to know which writes an approval covered. A seal moves on a row held on its role, and on a row the identity door rewrote after an account changed on Entra, which stops on TRASPORTO_IDENTITA_CAMBIATA with the new name in the register and the old one on the instance.

Where the log does not say, or the caller gave no approvers (NULL, a runner older than this function: without them a change IT approved would be passed over and the name read would be the one before it), the name executed is not known: username is emptied, so that no server is asked about a name that may not be the one executed, and the row is not judged on its access. server and project_id stay the register's then.

Applied rows, and every row outside conta and ferma of report_scope(), keep the register's values.
